reason: This is a cross-subsystem refactor in the DDL-to-statistics notification path, not a routine local fix. It changes statistics DDL handling interfaces and the notifier/event model across multiple core DDL entry points, including partition removal and flashback flows. Those paths can silently break stats refresh/invalidation and lead to optimizer/cardinality regressions with broad blast radius, so it is worth a focused deep review for high-severity correctness gaps.
